name: Dumbbell curl
description: Curl a dumbbell up with your elbow fixed at your side, then lower it slowly.

name: Hammer curl
description: Curl with palms facing each other to work the biceps and forearms.

name: Concentration curl
description: Sit with your elbow resting on your inner thigh and curl the dumbbell slowly.

name: Barbell curl
description: Curl a barbell from thigh height to shoulder height, keeping your elbows still.

name: Incline dumbbell curl
description: Lie back on an incline bench and curl with your arms hanging behind you for a deep stretch.

name: Band curl
description: Stand on a band and curl your hands up, keeping your elbows close to your body.

name: Cable curl
description: Curl a cable handle up with steady tension through the full range.

name: Chin-up
description: Grip the bar with palms facing you and pull your chin over it with control.
caution: Lower under control. Avoid kipping if your elbows or shoulders are sore.

name: Zottman curl
description: Curl up with palms up, rotate at the top, and lower with palms down.

name: Isometric curl hold
description: Hold a dumbbell at the middle of a curl and resist for a set time.

name: Seated band curl
description: Sit tall with a band under your feet and curl your hands up with your elbows close to your sides.
